display_name: Percentage of undergraduates receiving grants or scholarships
definition: Percentage of all undergraduate students awarded grant or scholarship aid from federal, state/local, institutional, or other sources known to the institution.
population: All undergraduates in the financial-aid reporting population
does_not_measure: Any financial aid including loans and work-study, or exclusively Yale-funded need-based aid

comparability.finding: The same named measure and physical columns are present in both releases. This example does not certify every aspect of longitudinal comparability.
required_checks: Confirm population and grant/scholarship coverage agree across years
Confirm annual reporting periods and denominator basis
Check missing/suppressed values before presenting a trend

calculation_rules.institution_rate: Use the published percentage; retain original rounding. A separately labeled calculation may use 100 * recipient count / population count when both counts are valid and definitions match.
calculation_rules.aggregation: Never sum percentages. Multi-institution aggregation requires its own validated population, reporting-unit and matched-count rules.
calculation_rules.missing_values: Preserve missingness; do not replace absent values with zero.
